items.content_html:
Authorization for Credit Card Transactions - now available on Fillvisa Plus.

What's new

Fill G-1450 in Plus and attach it to any case that requires credit card payment, so filing fees and paperwork move together.

Why Plus

G-1450 is a payment authorization tied to a professional's filing on a client's behalf, not something a self-filer typically submits alone - so it belongs in Plus alongside the rest of the case's paperwork.

What's next

More EB-1 through EB-5 forms are on the way. Follow this changelog for updates as they ship.

Have a form you'd like to see next? Let us know - we're building this around what practitioners actually need.

items.content_html:
The Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker is now available on Fillvisa Plus.

What's new

Attorneys and PERM specialists can now fill, manage, and generate I-140 petitions directly in Plus - alongside the rest of the PERM workflow (ETA-9089, ETA-9141, G-28).

Why Plus

I-140 is filed by an employer or their representative on behalf of a beneficiary, not self-filed - so it lives where the case management and firm-level tooling already are, rather than on Fillvisa Free.

What's next

More EB-1 through EB-5 forms are on the way. Follow this changelog for updates as they ship.

Questions or a form you'd like to see prioritized? Reach out - we're building this based on what practitioners actually need.

items.content_html:
The I-130, Petition for Alien Relative, is now available on Fillvisa - and it's live on Fillvisa Free.

If you're a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident petitioning for a spouse, parent, child, or sibling, you can now fill out the I-130 directly in your browser - no account, no server uploads, nothing ever leaves your device.

What you can do:

  • Fill out the I-130 form field-by-field with guided help
  • Generate an official, submission-ready PDF
  • Keep everything private - Fillvisa Free never touches a server

Petitioners self-filing for a family member are exactly who this tool is built for. Give it a try at fillvisa.com

items.title: DS-160 autofill: all fields now fill correctly
items.summary: We've pushed an update to the DS-160 form + autofill bookmarklet that resolves field-skipping issues reported by users. Previously, certain fields on the CEAC portal were being left blank during an autofill session - those fields now fill correctly, and with no delay. What changed…
items.content_html:
We've pushed an update to the DS-160 form + autofill bookmarklet that resolves field-skipping issues reported by users. Previously, certain fields on the CEAC portal were being left blank during an autofill session - those fields now fill correctly, and with no delay.

What changed

  • Fixed: fields that were silently skipped during autofill now populate as expected
  • Fixed: removed unintended delay between field fills - the sequence now runs smoothly end-to-end
  • Fixed: Added additional form page "spouse" for entering spouse details

If you're using the bookmarklet, re-install it from Fillvisa DS-160 to get the latest version. Reach out via the site if you run into anything unexpected.

items.title: Fixed: Form I-485 - PDF Field Length Error of Receipt Number of Underlying Petition
items.summary: What happened A user encountered an error when downloading a completed I-485: "I was trying to download my form when I received this error message: Attempted to set text with length=13 for TextField with maxLength=9 and name=principal_firstname" The eoir_number field in the underlying PDF spec…
items.content_html:
What happened

A user encountered an error when downloading a completed I-485:

"I was trying to download my form when I received this error message: Attempted to set text with length=13 for TextField with maxLength=9 and name=principal_firstname"

 

The eoir_number field in the underlying PDF spec had a maxLength of 9 - too short for many real Receipt Number of Underlying Petition. When the generated PDF tried to write a longer value into that field, it threw an error and blocked the download.

 

What was fixed

Updated the PDF field spec for eoir_number on Form I-485 to correctly reflect the actual allowed length. Downloads now complete without error regardless of name length.
